## Profile or directory change

- [ ] I am adding/updating my own profile, or am a maintainer handling an authorized request.
- [ ] My profile filename matches my lowercase GitHub username.
- [ ] Company IDs exist in `companies.json` (I added any new companies there).
- [ ] Employment status and referral preferences are accurate.
- [ ] I updated `lastVerified` to the date I verified my information.
- [ ] I consent to sharing these details with everyone who can access this repository.
- [ ] I did not edit generated company pages or the people index.
